Instructions for Use
Device description: The Zephyr Pacing System is a cardiac pacing system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Zephyr Pacing System is MR Conditional. A person with the Zephyr Pacing System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Zephyr Pacing System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T and 3.0T
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg; head SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: B1+rms ≤ 1.2 microtesla; Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Scan Duration at 3T: Maximum active scan time of 20 minutes.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
